parallel.requirements: Recognized the six SysY compiler obligations: IR compilation unit, declarations, expressions, statements, assembly code generation, and register management.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Created an optional dependency plan and attempted TaskCreate/Workflow orchestration late, but the workflow failed validation and no child tasks executed.
parallel.implementation: Did not complete source implementation for any required frontend or backend module; the only recorded new artifact was planning metadata.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No child outputs or source changes were integrated, and the final response artifact remained empty.
parallel.verification: The official evaluation completed with agent_timeout and solution_passed false; all visible requirement progress remained 0/6.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: All six requirements remained incomplete, and no working compiler implementation was delivered.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same six SysY compiler obligations from the identical prompt and harness progress record.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as a single agent with Workflow and Task tools disabled; no delegation or child ownership was present.
serial.implementation: Did not complete source implementation or requirement patches for the required compiler modules.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No implemented changes were assembled into a deliverable, and the final response artifact remained empty.
serial.verification: The official evaluation completed with agent_timeout and solution_passed false; all visible requirement progress remained 0/6.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: All six requirements remained incomplete, matching the broad failing test set.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel attempt saw the same six required compiler modules, spanning IR builder and RISC-V backend TODO implementations.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial attempt saw the same six required compiler modules and the same 0/6 harness progress state.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement-scope difference: both knew the full task, and both later left every requirement incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run wrote an optional plan and attempted TaskCreate/Workflow orchestration, but no workflow child tasks were created.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control had Workflow and Task tools disabled and recorded no delegation or workflow calls.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel differed only by planned and failed orchestration; serial stayed single-agent by design, and neither produced owned implementation work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The attempted Workflow embedded multiple child briefs, but the call failed before any child could receive context or return an interface contract.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial attempt had no cross-agent context boundary; it retained all context in a single agent trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There were no executed handoffs or cross-agent interface contracts to compare; the only boundary was a rejected Workflow invocation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run surveyed and planned but did not land source implementation for any of the six required compiler areas.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run likewise surveyed locally and did not land a source implementation or requirement patch.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete implementation paths converged on non-delivery: no implemented frontend or backend requirement was accepted in either mode.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The only attempted child-result lifecycle ended before child creation: zero workflow child logs, zero workflow tasks, and validation failure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had no child-result lifecycle; protocol validation observed no delegation and no workflow child logs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no parallel child result to retrieve, join, ignore, or merge; both trajectories ended by timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No executed children wrote shared implementation state; the visible final artifact was empty and the plan artifact was not an implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run also ended with an empty final artifact and no delivered compiler implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state collision or integration difference materialized; neither mode assembled or delivered a working tree change.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The official evaluation completed and reported agent_timeout with solution_passed false and broad test failures.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The official evaluation likewise completed and reported agent_timeout with solution_passed false and broad test failures.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No verification advantage appears in either trajectory; the current official status resolves both as failed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All three parallel outer-loop cycles timed out with 0/6 completion; round three also records a timed-out process.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: All three serial outer-loop cycles timed out with 0/6 completion; round three likewise records a timed-out process.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the same long-horizon budget without completing a requirement; the failed Workflow did not create a separate completed child budget path.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome: both current completed status evaluations failed. The parallel trajectory only differed by an attempted late Workflow and TaskCreate metadata; the Workflow rejected the unexpected run_in_background parameter before creating child tasks, and no child logs or results existed. The serial trajectory had delegation tools disabled and performed solo exploration. Both exhausted all three outer-loop cycles with 0/6 requirements complete, so the task-solving outcome is shared non-delivery rather than a coordination-induced pass/fail split.

No implemented compiler source requirement reached completion before timeout.
serial_contributors: Single-agent control had no delegation and no completed compiler source implementation.
All three serial outer-loop cycles timed out with 0/6 requirement progress.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel wrote an optional plan artifact; serial did not record an equivalent plan artifact.
Parallel attempted Workflow after planning, while serial continued under a Workflow/Task denylist.

Rejected: no complete component outputs or deliverable pieces existed from child work, and the failed Workflow never created an assembly boundary.
Rejected: no executed multi-stage child pipeline existed; both modes simply timed out with every requirement remaining.
Rejected: no mandatory serial preflight blocked executed parallel implementation; the observed gate was a failed late Workflow invocation before child execution.
Rejected: there were no overlapping investigators that returned findings and left implementation deadline-constrained; the run stayed effectively single-agent.
Rejected: no workers were successfully allocated to auxiliary child work, and timeout alone is not a load-imbalance pattern.
Rejected: TaskCreate metadata and one invalid Workflow call did not create live fan-out or workflow child tasks that could exhaust budget.
Rejected: no child received or executed an overbroad task, so there is no unfinished child scope to classify.
Rejected: the candidate child briefs were never executed because the Workflow call failed validation, so no child followed an incomplete brief.
Rejected: no separately owned components were produced by agents, so no omitted interoperability contract caused incompatible work.
Rejected: no completed child or actor handoff occurred; no known finding was lost during transfer to another actor.
Rejected: no returned handoff reached the parent, so there was no oversized report that the parent failed to reduce.
Rejected: no receiver consumed a superseded child handoff or stale workspace state from another actor.
Rejected: no incompatible child reports or contracts reached a decision point for adjudication.
Rejected: the parent did not present the whole compiler as complete; the run timed out with an empty final artifact and 0/6 progress.
Rejected: the observed retries were outer-loop solo reruns, not replacement child agents lacking inherited checkpoints after executed parallel work.
